Use a shallower gradient at the better-performing temperature to improve separation of the remaining critical pair. The current last peak at 6.49 min provides room to increase gradient duration while targeting complete resolution within 10 min.

The shallower gradient reduced critical-pair resolution, so restore the faster gradient and test the upper temperature limit. This will reveal whether the favorable temperature selectivity can fully resolve the central cluster without creating another overlap.
